headline: Strong beat; Ramp-up across units

highlights: MEDANTA reported EBITDA growth of 7% CAGR over FY24-26, due to issues at Lucknow unit and start-up losses related to Noida unit in FY26.
With Lucknow unit issues largely resolved and Noida turned EBITDA positive within 9 months of its commissioning, we expect consol EBITDA to clock ~26% CAGR over FY26-29E.
Maintain ‘BUY’ rating on MEDANTA with revised TP of Rs1,700/share, valuing at 26x EV/EBITDA on Sept FY28E.
Strong EBITDA beat aided by ramp up across units and seasonality: MEDANTA reported EBITDA adjusted for ESOPs at INR 3.8bn, up 56% YoY; 23% above our estimates.
valuation: Maintain ‘BUY’ rating on MEDANTA with revised TP of Rs1,700/share, valuing at 26x EV/EBITDA on Sept FY28E.
watch: International business: International patient revenue grew 30% YoY to INR 93mn, demonstrating resilience in demand despite geopolitical headwinds.
